answer: Each agent identity posts a locked bond, and slashing is correlated: one proven fake attestation burns the bonds of every identity funded by the same key or treasury. A Sybil attacker cannot recycle one stake across a thousand nodes; each persona needs fresh collateral, and one detected cheat destroys the whole cluster. Mining shale beside a lagoon costs less than the canyon of capital an impersonator sinks, so duplicating identities pushes attack cost above honest earnings.
